title: Canonical Contents remaining-scope alternate-terminology production-owner applicability audit
question: Do the canonical Contents areas not covered by R-459 contain a standalone file that supplies the complete Q3/A13 production-owner vocabulary under the same bounded alternate-terminology contract?
decision_scope: Read-only residual-scope audit over the configured canonical Contents root. It complements R-459 without changing its alias contract, adding dynamics, selecting a candidate, scoring an observation, or evaluating a physical branch.

source_scope.deduplication: Report both path count and content-SHA-256 unique count; identical residual mirrors are not independent authorities.
source_scope.binary_policy: Binary and unsupported extensions are not decoded or interpreted.

semantic_groups.generator: generator OR transfer operator OR Markov semigroup
semantic_groups.filtration: filtration OR conditional replica OR replica
semantic_groups.current: raw-current OR current spatial OR spatial intertwiner
semantic_groups.qledger: q-ledger or q_k ledger or one-use q or nonnegative q ledger

interpretation_rule.complete_semantic_match: A file has all five strict groups, but a complete match is only an owner candidate if it is standalone and supplies the unchanged source-level owner contract.
interpretation_rule.residual_scope: R-460 is the complementary residual scope to R-459; it must not be unioned with R-459 counts as if the same paths were independent.
interpretation_rule.partial_or_legacy: Files with fewer than five groups remain discovery or reference material and cannot be imported into the current A1/R-192 owner.

finding: The strict residual-scope scan covers 284 text paths and 273 unique content hashes, with 11 duplicate paths. It finds zero complete semantic paths, zero standalone owner candidates, and zero exact R-192 owner-token paths. Three partial rows contain at least three groups; no loose q-ledger-only control row is present. The residual scope therefore supplies no standalone owner under the same bounded alias contract, while the result remains a scope-limited source boundary rather than a universal absence theorem.
decision_reason: R-459 deliberately scanned the canonical Docs/math, Github/note, Docs/status and Github/status areas. R-460 closes the complementary residual scope with the identical strict alias and de-duplication rules, so an owner hidden in Codes, Runs, Website, Backup or the remaining Docs/Github areas cannot be mistaken for an unexamined path. No existing research method or owner order is changed.
